name: Whoosh
description:
Touchpad window and GNOME dash gestures plus touchscreen title-bar dragging for GNOME Shell. Swipe title bars to tile, maximize, or minimize; pinch to close or fullscreen. In GNOME Overview, hover a window preview and use the same two-finger swipe gestures to tile, maximize, minimize, or corner-tile that window. Touchscreen title-bar drags support release-to-tile gestures, corner tiling, and dragging windows out of maximized state. Over dash apps, swipe up to maximize the preferred window, swipe down to minimize all windows, pinch in to quit, and pinch out to open a new window on a new workspace.

Requires the Whoosh backend from the project repository.
